scenario_text:
Reporting estate for our finance team. About 12 analysts, and each of them
writes their own large aggregate queries across roughly 90 GB of ledger
history — they're exploratory, so two people rarely run the same thing twice.
They get at it through a browser-based SQL console. Results come back when
they come back; nobody is waiting on a millisecond budget. Host is 8 GB RAM,
4 vCPU. Internal data only, but back it up nightly.
